commits.summary: Replay five merged Java changes with durable MySQL readback (verification pending)
commits.body:
Add examples 453–457 for the 17 registered N01–N05 questions. All 34 fresh public JVM histories ran against the original parent or merge JARs. All seven intents changed as predicted, all five controls were identical, and every merged prediction held. Both Esri parent touch directions threw, while extending the reversed subtractor removed precisely A–B on both revisions.

Exercise Spring JDBC on a disposable MySQL 9.1.0 InnoDB database. Each allocation reads its real connection-local maximum. A separate connection sees 98 after rollback or 100 after commit followed by a restoration failure. The parent produced a duplicate insert after rollback. The merged allocator returned 99, 100, 101 after rollback and 101, 102, 103 after the committed failure.

All five ordinary example validators replayed their histories. All 55 selected suites passed, as did the three previous campaign audits. Negative checks rejected swapped artifacts, an omitted calendar intent, a false durable state, and an incorrect server version. The geometry oracle detected duplicate, missing and foreign intervals, and accepted reversed and split edges. Four local debugger trials confirmed the changed British period method.

Job 20261125-232607-replay-the-17-n01-n05-predictions-with-m independently repeats all 34 histories and compares the audit byte for byte. Jobs 20261125-233153-trace-option-default-reuse-and-histogram and 20261125-233153-trace-calendar-period-readback-and-esri check 40 original-method JVM trials.

commits.summary: Record all three completed N01–N05 verification jobs
commits.body:
The independent comparison reran all 34 public histories, including both failure boundaries and the ordinary control on a fresh MySQL 9.1.0 server. Its audit was byte-identical to the registered results. Two debugger jobs qualified 40 additional JVM trials through the four registered original methods.

Reopened all four collected debugger reports and checked every selected input, invocation site, caller class, dependency and original return against the campaign. All 14 results-page links resolve. The documentation-only change selects no additional test suites.
